subject: Tenant bootstrap & access sprint — BlueHalo MAP items
messages:
From: Nicole Torres <nicole.torres@bluehalo.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Reid <alex.reid@bluehalo.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:23:00 -0800
Subject: Tenant bootstrap & access sprint — BlueHalo MAP items

Hi Karthik / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — BlueHalo is keen to move the eval to a short, focused MAP sprint so we can validate latency and cost for our image-annotation pipeline. Before we kick off we need to lock down org bootstrap + access so our infra team can open the VPC peering request and schedule a maintenance window. Concrete asks from our side: 

- Recommended approach for API keys: do you provide long-lived service keys per tenant or do you recommend short-lived tokens + service account exchange?
- Org admin creation: we need an RBAC mapping doc (who is Owner / Admin / Dev) so our SSO team can sync.
- IP allowlist: preferred CIDR ranges on your side so we can check overlap with our VPCs.
- VPC peering: we'll need your account ID and any security policy templates you expect.

Attaching an initial SOW draft and our security questionnaire for your security team.

Attachments: bluehalo-sow.pdf (application/pdf), security-questionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Can we aim to get the infra inputs by EOD Monday (Nov 22)? That would let us schedule the peering for the week of Nov 29 and run a canary test the following week.

Thanks,
Nicole
Nicole Torres
Head of ML Ops, BlueHalo Systems
nicole.torres@bluehalo.com
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Nicole Torres <nicole.torres@bluehalo.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 17:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Tenant bootstrap & access sprint — BlueHalo MAP items

Nicole — thanks, and great to hear BlueHalo wants to move quickly. Below is a concise MAP-style sprint plan that covers the items you listed. Proposing owners and dates so this can slot straight into your runbooks.

MAP Sprint: Tenant Bootstrap & Access (compressed 2-week sprint)
- Owner / Coordinator: karthik_iyer (Redwood Solutions) — kickoff Thurs Nov 19, 10:00 PT
- CS Lead: grace_oconnor (Redwood) — onboarding + canary test owner
- Infra Lead (BlueHalo): Alex Reid — provide AWS account IDs and CIDR by Mon Nov 22

Action items (owner — due):
1) API key pattern & Service accounts — karthik_iyer — Due Mon Nov 22
   - Recommendation: short-lived API tokens backed by a service account credential exchange (we'll provide an example implementation and a Lambda-friendly token rotation script).
   - Long-lived keys are supported for Dedicated/Dedicated-like flows; for this eval we recommend short-lived tokens scoped to the tenant to reduce blast radius.
2) Org + RBAC mapping — ben_carter & grace_oconnor — Due Mon Nov 22
   - We'll send an RBAC CSV template to import into your SSO/IDP (Owner, Admin, Engineer, Readonly).
3) IP allowlist & CIDR alignment — Alex (BlueHalo) to provide your public CIDRs; Redwood recommends allowing 3 x /28 ranges for staging + canary + control plane.
4) VPC peering details — karthik_iyer to provide Redwood account ID and peering checklist; BlueHalo to submit peering request to their AWS team — Due Wed Nov 24
5) Canary test plan & success criteria — grace_oconnor — Due Fri Nov 26

Security notes:
- We'll share SOC2 evidence badges and our transient logging policy (retention 30 days by default for the eval).
- If you need HSM/KMS integration we'll list required KMS key IDs and access grants in the peering checklist.

Related links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/9876543/DH-2026-0427) and a draft RBAC import sheet (we'll upload to the Drive folder and share).

Next steps:
- Kickoff call: Nov 19, 10:00 PT — 30m sync to confirm owners and schedule peering window. I will send calendar invite.

- I'll attach the token-exchange example and the peering checklist in a follow-up email (short snippets for your infra team).

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Solution Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Nicole Torres <nicole.torres@bluehalo.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Reid <alex.reid@bluehalo.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:41:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Tenant bootstrap & access sprint — BlueHalo MAP items

Thanks Karthik — that format is perfect. A few clarifications from our infra/security team: 

- We prefer a short-lived token flow (rotation automated) — can you confirm max token TTL you support out of the box?
- For IP ranges: our current egress NATs are 198.51.100.0/24 and 203.0.113.0/24; we'll aim to open three ephemeral /28 blocks that do not overlap — will that be fine?
- Peering: bluehalo AWS account ID is 987654321000; we'll submit once we have your account ID and the peering template.

Also adding our security contact in case you need to route the questionnaire: it-support@bluehalo.com

Nicole

Nicole, Alex — looping in a few practical items from the CS side to make the peering + canary smooth: 

- Redwood account ID for peering: 112233445566
- Peering checklist (high level): accept peering confirmation, update route tables for staging subnet, add three /28 blocks we will provide to your allowlist for the canary, and run an application-level smoke test (we'll provide curl examples).
- Canary plan: run 50 requests/min for 30 minutes from your staging VPC, measure p95 latency and token costs. Success = p95 latency within 1.5x of our baseline + error rate < 1%.

I'll drop the peering template and a sample token-refresh Lambda in the shared Drive folder by EOD. Also happy to set up a 30m infra deep-dive during the kickoff for any follow-ups.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Quick follow-up after the kickoff and infra sync this morning. Thanks Alex for providing the account ID. Confirming the concrete deliverables we uploaded to the shared folder:

- Token exchange example (node/python) + recommended TTL: 15 minutes default, up to 60 minutes configurable for evals where rotated keys are impractical.
- RBAC CSV template: measures for Owner / Admin / Engineer / Readonly.
- Peering checklist and CloudFormation snippet for route updates.
- Canary test curl samples and the pass/fail script (p95 + error threshold).

Tentative schedule:
- Mon Nov 22: BlueHalo provides final CIDRs and completes RBAC CSV
- Wed Nov 24: BlueHalo submits peering request (account 987654321000)
- Tue Nov 30: Peering accepted + route tables set; canary test scheduled for Wed Dec 1

If any of these dates are tight for BlueHalo, flag the item and we can adjust. Otherwise we'll proceed and circle back with results after the canary.

Cheers,
Karthik
